items.title: Pope Leo speaks of community 'suffering' on visit to remote Andes town
items.dek: Santa Cruz de Succhabamba is part of the Diocese of Chiclayo, where the Pope served as bishop from 2015 to 2023.

items.title: Fifth Canadian soldier dies from injuries caused by large fire at military base
items.dek: Pte William Douglas Dal Bianco died from his injuries on Friday, a month after a fire that tore through CFB Wainwright.
